name: ue5-shaders
description: Unreal Engine 5 HLSL shader tree (Engine/Shaders) reference for UE 5.7.4+. Material translator slots, Vertex Factory contract, BasePass/ShadowDepth/Velocity passes, legacy ShadingModels (BRDF, GBuffer encoding), Substrate closure-tree BSDF, Lumen GI/Reflections, Nanite, VSM, TSR, Ray/Path Tracing, Sky Atmosphere, Volumetric Cloud, Translucency/OIT/Decals/MegaLights/SSRT/HairStrands, post-process, Mobile path, GPU Scene/Instance Culling, MaterialCache, Distance Field
